subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is 'welcoming'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• Let us look into the meaning of the given options - 
 
 
• greeting - the faculty or state of being able to see.
 
• welcoming - allow or cause (something) to be visible.
 
• pleasing - the action or fact of seeing someone or something.
 
• warming - a small round or roundish mark, differing in colour or texture from the surface around it.
 
 
 
• The sentence with the blank talks about the subject seeing the tall trees. 
 
• In such a case, **welcoming** or option 2 is the correct word for the given blank. 

*Correct passage - **She was flying over the hills and felt delighted at the (1) sight of the tall trees and their (2) sloping branches below her. She could (3) even see a river flowing in a zig-zag fashion. Birds (4) flew alongside making chirruping sounds as if (5) **welcoming **her to the skies.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Although vision and sight are often synonymous, they have a subtle difference. 
 
• While sight happens primarily in the eye, vision happens in the brain.
 
• Vision is the brain's ability to process the information coming from the eyes. When the eyes pick up an image, a quick process begins for that image to be translated and understood by the brain.
